Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje industriale
Join Jungheinrich in a working environment where you can make a big difference! With your knowledge and drive, as a team player you will make an important contribution to ensure that we as a company continue to be among the global leaders in our industry. Working side by side with colleagues who enjoy bold ideas and in a family environment that offers you every opportunity to reconcile your professional and private goals.
 Join Our International Finance Team at Jungheinrich Business Excellence Center Romania! 
Are you ready to take the next step in your finance career and become part of a global organization that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous development?
 Jungheinrich Business Excellence Center Romania is growing, and we are looking for talented finance professionals who are fluent in Dutch / Spanish/Portuguese to join our international teams in the following areas:
🔹 Accounts Payable (AP) 
🔹 Accounts Receivable (AR) 
As part of our Business Excellence Center, you will have the opportunity to contribute to key financial processes that support Jungheinrich operations across multiple countries while working in a diverse and multicultural environment.
 What we are looking for 
✔ Professional experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable or other finance-related areas
✔ Fluent Dutch/Spanish/Portuguese language skills
✔ Strong communication and collaboration abilities
✔ A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn and grow in an international setting
 Why Jungheinrich? 
 At Jungheinrich, we believe that our people make the difference. By joining our Business Excellence Center in Romania, you will benefit from:
An international working environment with colleagues from across Europe
Opportunities for professional and personal development
A supportive and collaborative team culture
The chance to contribute to meaningful projects within a leading global intralogistics company
A workplace that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement
Whether you are an experienced finance professional or looking to further develop your expertise in AP, AR, or GL, we would love to connect with you.
 Bring your language skills, finance knowledge, and ambition to Jungheinrich Business Excellence Center Romania and grow your career with us. 
 Jungheinrich was founded in 1953 in Hamburg by Dr. Friedrich Jungheinrich as a family business. Today, we are one of the world's leading intralogistics companies with a unique product portfolio: from conventional industrial trucks to fully automated solutions intralogistics companies. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Jungheinrich is represented by its own direct sales companies in 41 countries and by partner companies in around 80 other countries around the world, and employs more than 19,000 people internationally.
 We look forward to receiving your online application.
 For questions, please contact our Recruiter.
 At Jungheinrich, we value inclusion and diversity and practice equity to create equal opportunities for all. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, ethnic background, color, religious affiliation, union affiliation, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, nationality, genetics and health or disability.
